scope: Outbox lock + retry + dead-letter, Pusher channel auth, polling fallback cadence, eventual consistency between outbox write and KDS read

outbox_write_idempotency.evidence: sha1(event_type|aggregate_id) → UNIQUE idempotency_key. wasRecentlyCreated short-circuit at :57 avoids redundant DispatchDomainEventsJob dispatch on replay.

broadcast_claim_atomicity.evidence: DB::transaction wraps lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard + claim mutation. Phase 2 (broadcast) runs OUTSIDE the transaction (line 97 comment) so the row is unlocked before network I/O.

retry_policy.evidence: $backoff = [1, 5, 15, 60, 300], $tries = 6. Worst-case retry window ≈ 1+5+15+60+300 = 381s ≈ 6.4 min. Audit T G2 (2026-04-23) explicitly fixed tries=5→6 so the 300s trailing entry is reachable.
retry_policy.verdict: PASS — outlasts typical Pusher/Soketi restart (1-3 min).

dead_letter_handling.evidence: failed() handler stamps DomainEvent.last_error with 'contract_violation: ' prefix preserved (Audit T G1) so monitoring filters keying on this prefix keep working at terminal failure. Optional Sentry breadcrumb at :226-236.
dead_letter_handling.verdict: PASS — terminal failures are pager-grade Log::error, not warning.

retry_sweep_cron.evidence: Three retry/sweep paths exist. OutboxRetryFailedCommand is DIRTY (not read — out of scope per master mandate). OutboxConcurrentRetryLockTest (tests/Feature/Outbox/OutboxConcurrentRetryLockTest.php) covers 5 invariants: skip when lock held, acquire+release, cap at 500 rows, lock TTL = 300s, webhook variant parity.
retry_sweep_cron.verdict: PASS — strong test coverage; cron DIRTY observed only.

polling_fallback_cadence.evidence: sync() bucket is minute-level (line 40 minuteBucket = YmdHi). Cache::remember 5s TTL on the delta payload (line 49). Client clamp is documented as 5-60s in cited authority MEGA_PLAN_SYNC_HARDENING_v3 (file header).
polling_fallback_cadence.verdict: PASS — server-side TTL 5s gives sub-10s eventual consistency under polling fallback.

broadcast_heartbeat_observability.evidence: ws:heartbeat cache key stamped on successful broadcast (best-effort, swallowed on error). 120s TTL > 4× the 30s polling_fallback_ms. GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 S-P0-A heal R1 SRE-001: previously read by SyncOverviewController:531 but never written → dashboard stayed green-emerald while Pusher died. Now correctly written.

findings.title: DispatchDomainEventsJob ONLY runs via the queue or retry cron — no direct broadcast path if queue is down
findings.evidence_read: DispatchDomainEventsJob::dispatch wrapped in try/Throwable (line 67-78). On dispatch failure, only Log::warning. The job lands in queue 'high' (DispatchDomainEventsJob:46). If Redis/db queue connection is down at dispatch time, the warning is the ONLY signal.
findings.impact: Outbox row exists with dispatched_at=null. MonitorOutboxStaleness cron (file exists) presumably picks this up but cadence is the gap. KDS polling fallback compensates via direct DB read in KdsSyncService.
findings.recommendation: Verify MonitorOutboxStaleness cron cadence ≤ 60s and that stale outbox alerts fire to pager. PK-4 RESILIENCE territory.

findings.title: 5-second cache on KdsSyncService.sync() amplifies thundering herd on cache expiry
findings.evidence_read: Cache::remember($cacheKey, 5, function() ...) — branch-keyed minute-bucketed key. If 50 KDS clients all poll at second 4.9 of cache TTL, all 50 trigger a recompute simultaneously.
findings.impact: For Le Cayenne single-branch with ≤3 KDS terminals, negligible (3 concurrent recomputes max). At scale (V2 SaaS with N branches × M terminals), this needs lock_for_get semantics or staggered TTL.
findings.recommendation: V2 SaaS concern; for V1 single-branch with ≤5 KDS terminals, current behavior is acceptable.

findings.title: Eventual consistency window between outbox write and KDS poll = 0..5s + network
findings.evidence_read: Outbox row commits in PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox synchronously with the order. KDS poll cache TTL = 5s. So worst-case KDS sees order ~5s after order_datetime regardless of broadcast success.
findings.impact: Broadcast push reduces this to <1s (sub-second Pusher round-trip). Polling fallback ceiling = 5s. Within V1 SLA.
findings.recommendation: None — by design. Document this SLA in operator playbook.

findings.title: No metric on broadcast latency p95 in this cascade — emitted but not aggregated visibly
findings.evidence_read: SyncMetricsRecorder->recordEventDispatched is called with dispatch latency in ms (line 143 = diffInMilliseconds from $domainEvent->occurred_at). Doc comment cites SLO outbox_dispatch_latency_p95 < 2s.
findings.impact: Metric is recorded but aggregation/dashboard visibility is presumed elsewhere (admin observability page). Not verifiable from this cascade alone.
findings.recommendation: Verify the admin observability dashboard reads SyncMetricsRecorder.recordEventDispatched data with p95 panel. PK-4 territory.

keeps: Atomic claim pattern (DispatchDomainEventsJob:65-86) — lockForUpdate + dispatched_at guard. NEW-01 invariant.
Backoff curve fix tries=6 (Audit T G2 2026-04-23) — 300s trailing entry now reachable.
ws:heartbeat write-then-read pattern (DispatchDomainEventsJob:127-131) — GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 S-P0-A heal R1 SRE-001 closed.
SyncMetricsRecorder defensive double try/catch (DispatchDomainEventsJob:139-148 + recorder-internal) — observability cannot break the cascade.
Cache TTL 5s + branch-keyed minute bucket (KdsSyncService:40-47) — bounded cache cardinality.
